NATS JetStream vs RabbitMQ: Which Architecture Actually Scales in Production? ⚡

• Throughput: NATS JetStream offers significantly higher throughput due to its lightweight design and efficient streaming capabilities.
• Latency: NATS JetStream generally provides lower latency, especially for high-volume streaming scenarios.
• Consistency: RabbitMQ offers more robust transactional guarantees and complex routing options, while NATS JetStream leans towards eventual consistency with strong streaming primitives.
• Failure Modes: Both are resilient, but NATS JetStream's simpler model can lead to more predictable behavior under load.
• Operational Overhead: NATS JetStream is often considered simpler to operate and scale horizontally compared to RabbitMQ.

Recommendation: For high-throughput, low-latency, and simpler operational scaling in production, NATS JetStream often has the edge. RabbitMQ excels in scenarios requiring complex routing and strong transactional guarantees.
